title: 第1847章 乱流深处寻秘境归墟入口现真容第1846章 星辰为食固根基混洞初成天地惊
content_zh:
林玄告别天机真人，按照那幅星图的指引，朝混沌大世界的边缘飞去。
那片混沌乱流，位于混沌大世界的最深处，是一片连星辰都无法存在的死寂区域。
林玄飞了整整七天，周围的星辰越来越稀疏，最后彻底消失。
前方，只剩下一片无尽的灰色。
那是一片混沌乱流。
远远看去，那片混沌乱流就像一片灰色的海洋，无边无际。
乱流中，无数灰色的混沌之气在疯狂翻滚，形成一道道恐怖的混沌风暴。它们相互碰撞，相互吞噬，发出震耳欲聋的轰鸣声。
整片混沌乱流，散发着一种古老而危险的气息，仿佛一头沉睡的远古凶兽，在等待着猎物上门。
林玄站在混沌乱流边缘，目光平静。
他清晰地感觉到，那片混沌乱流中蕴含的毁灭之力，就算是混洞境的强者贸然闯入，也会被那些混沌风暴撕碎。
但他没有犹豫，迈步踏入混沌乱流。
他刚踏入乱流，一股恐怖的混沌风暴就向他席卷而来。
那风暴蕴含着恐怖的混沌之力，足以撕碎任何混洞境以下的强者。
林玄看着那股席卷而来的风暴，没有躲闪。
抬手，体内的混洞猛然旋转起来。
一股灰色的吞噬之力从他掌心涌出，在他身前形成一个灰色的漩涡。
那股混沌风暴撞在灰色漩涡上，直接被漩涡吞噬。风暴中的混沌之力，被漩涡吸入，涌入林玄体内，被他的混洞炼化，成为他的力量。
林玄感受着那股被炼化的力量，目光淡定。
这里的混沌之力，比外面的更加精纯，更加浓郁。如果能在这里修炼一段时间，他的修为，一定能快速提升。
但他知道，他还不能停下，因为现在，还不是时候。

他迈步，继续朝混沌乱流深处走去。
他走在混沌乱流中，周围的混沌风暴不断朝他席卷而来。
体内的混洞，在不断旋转，将那些风暴全部吞噬。
他走过的地方，那些混沌风暴纷纷消散，仿佛被他吸干了力量。
他走了大约三天时间，前方的混沌乱流越来越浓郁，混沌风暴也越来越狂暴。
到了最后，那些风暴的威力已经足以威胁到混洞境的强者了。
林玄的步伐，也开始变得缓慢。
他体内的混洞在疯狂旋转，吞噬着周围的一切。
但他的吞噬速度，已经跟不上那些风暴的攻击速度了。
他的身体开始被那些风暴击中，留下一道道伤口。
但他没有停下，咬着牙，继续前进。
他知道，自己不能停下。
一旦停下，他就会被这片混沌乱流吞噬。
他只能前进，一直前进，直到找到归墟秘境的入口。
他又走了两天时间。
这两天，他身上的伤口越来越多，衣袍已被鲜血染红，他的气息也开始变得虚弱，但他依然没有停下。
他的目光，依然坚定。
终于，在第五天的时候，前方出现了一道巨大的裂缝。
那道裂缝横亘在混沌乱流中，长达数万丈，宽达数千丈。
裂缝中是一片无尽的黑暗，黑暗中，散发着一种古老而恐怖的气息，比混沌乱流中的气息，更加古老，更加恐怖。
content_en:
Lin Xuan bid farewell to Master Tianji and flew towards the edge of the chaotic world according to the guidance of the star map.
That chaotic turbulence is located in the deepest part of the chaotic world. It is a dead and silent area where even stars cannot exist.
Lin Xuan flew for seven days, and the stars around him became increasingly sparse and finally disappeared completely.
Ahead, there is only an endless gray.
It was chaos.
Seen from a distance, the chaotic turbulence is like a gray ocean, boundless.
In the turbulent flow, countless gray chaotic energy rolled crazily, forming terrifying chaotic storms. They collided with each other, devoured each other, and made a deafening roar.
The entire chaotic turbulence exudes an ancient and dangerous atmosphere, like a sleeping ancient ferocious beast, waiting for its prey to come.
Lin Xuan stood on the edge of the chaotic flow, his eyes calm.
He clearly felt that the destructive power contained in the chaotic flow would be torn apart by those chaotic storms even if a strong man from the Chaotic Cave Realm broke in rashly.
But he didn't hesitate and stepped into the chaos.
As soon as he stepped into the turbulent flow, a terrifying storm of chaos swept towards him.
That storm contained terrifying power of chaos, enough to tear apart any strong person below the Chaotic Cave Realm.
Lin Xuan looked at the sweeping storm and did not dodge.
Raising his hand, the hole in his body suddenly started to spin.
A gray devouring power surged out from his palm, forming a gray vortex in front of him.
The chaotic storm hit the gray vortex and was directly swallowed by the vortex. The power of chaos in the storm was sucked into the vortex, poured into Lin Xuan's body, and was refined by his Chaos Cave to become his power.
Lin Xuan felt the refined power and his eyes were calm.
The power of chaos here is purer and richer than that outside. If he can practice here for a period of time, his cultivation level will definitely improve quickly.
But he knew that he couldn't stop yet, because now was not the time.
He took steps and continued walking towards the depths of the chaos.
He walked in the chaotic turbulence, and the chaotic storm around him kept sweeping towards him.
The chaotic hole in the body is constantly rotating, swallowing up all those storms.
Wherever he walked, those chaotic storms dissipated one after another, as if they had been drained of their power by him.
He walked for about three days, and the chaotic turbulence ahead became more and more intense, and the chaotic storm became more and more violent.
In the end, the power of those storms was enough to threaten the strong men in the Hundong Realm.
Lin Xuan's pace also began to slow down.
The hole in his body was spinning wildly, swallowing everything around him.
But his devouring speed could no longer keep up with the attack speed of those storms.
His body began to be hit by those storms, leaving wounds.
But he didn't stop, gritted his teeth, and kept moving forward.
He knew he couldn't stop.
Once he stops, he will be swallowed up by this chaos.
He could only move forward, and keep moving forward until he found the entrance to the secret realm of Guixu.
He walked for two more days.
In the past two days, there were more and more wounds on his body, his clothes were stained red with blood, and his breath began to become weak, but he still did not stop.
His gaze remained firm.
Finally, on the fifth day, a huge crack appeared in front.
The crack stretched across the chaotic turbulence, tens of thousands of feet long and thousands of feet wide.
There is an endless darkness in the crack. In the darkness, there is an ancient and terrifying aura, which is older and more terrifying than the aura in the chaotic flow.
